build.buildCommand: export PATH=/opt/node-runtime/bin:$PATH && test "$(node --version)" = v24.22.2 && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: export NODE_ENV=production PATH=/opt/node-runtime/bin:$PATH && test "$(node --version)" = v24.22.2 && node --version && exec /opt/node-runtime/bin/node dist/index.cjs
